findings.finding: Hard external termination can lose all RAM-only completed cells and aggregate CPU/RSS costs; pre-try failures also lack an aggregate receipt. The 90-second check is before each cell only, and numerical supervision/RSS limits are not bound in the reviewed packet.
findings.bounded_resolution: Retain minimal durable per-cell progress plus the existing supervisor's attempt/termination/cost receipt, or bind evidence that existing supervision already retains these. Bind the concrete external timeout and CPU/RSS cap invocation.

FP32_bound_qualification: Conservative under the ordinary finite normalized FP32 arithmetic model with TF32 disabled; no generic per-step underflow/overflow guard is present. Actual head/cache values were not read and no mismatch is asserted.
